note: This file is a declarative MMPose configuration file containing only variable assignments and dictionary literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines hyperparameters, model architecture, data pipelines, and training settings for the Sapiens 2B pose estimation model on the Goliath dataset.
review_sapiens_2b_config: review the sapiens 2b pose estimation config for goliath dataset with 1024x768 image size
summarize_sapiens_2b_config: summarize the sapiens 2b training config including optimizer, scheduler, and dataset settings
refactor_sapiens_2b_config: refactor the sapiens 2b config to change learning rate, epochs, or image resolution
build_sapiens_2b_finetune_config: build a new sapiens 2b finetuning config based on the goliath 210 epoch template
test_sapiens_2b_config: test the sapiens 2b config by validating model, dataset, and pipeline definitions
